authoring_note: Conceptual reference mappings, authored against the supplier implementation.
disclaimer: Supplier invoice review is the intended purpose. These are reference control mappings, not a claim that this deployment is high-risk or certified compliant. Applicability requires an assessment of intended purpose and deployment context.

rows.honest_scope: Finite fixture tests, not a lifecycle risk-management system.
rows.iso_42001: Conceptual alignment: documented controls and review evidence; no clause-level conformity claim.
rows.mechanism: Executable failure cases and control probes.

rows.honest_scope: Operational input provenance; no training data or representativeness study.
rows.iso_42001: Conceptual alignment: documented controls and review evidence; no clause-level conformity claim.
rows.mechanism: Versioned contract snapshot and typed supplier input.

rows.honest_scope: In-memory recording; no production custody, retention or tamper-proof storage.
rows.iso_42001: Conceptual alignment: documented controls and review evidence; no clause-level conformity claim.
rows.mechanism: Ordered immutable event records include actors and outcomes.

rows.honest_scope: Configured identity allowlist in a reference runner, not deployed authentication or staff training.
rows.iso_42001: Conceptual alignment: documented controls and review evidence; no clause-level conformity claim.
rows.mechanism: The workflow suspends for an allowlisted reviewer.

rows.honest_scope: Computed structured findings; no claim of explaining a live model.
rows.iso_42001: Conceptual alignment: documented controls and review evidence; no clause-level conformity claim.
rows.mechanism: Verified findings and failed checks are packaged for review.

rows.honest_scope: No live-model accuracy benchmark or comprehensive security certification.
rows.iso_42001: Conceptual alignment: documented controls and review evidence; no clause-level conformity claim.
rows.mechanism: Typed inputs, Decimal arithmetic and tested rejection paths.

rows.honest_scope: Technical demonstration, not a determination that deployer obligations apply.
rows.iso_42001: Conceptual alignment: documented controls and review evidence; no clause-level conformity claim.
rows.mechanism: Named decisions and correction history are recorded.

rows.honest_scope: A reference specification, not a conformity dossier.
rows.iso_42001: Conceptual alignment: documented controls and review evidence; no clause-level conformity claim.
rows.mechanism: Documented supplier purpose, behavior and integration limits.
